clause_mappings.requirement: Senior site management shall prepare a food safety policy statement, outline organizational reporting structure, define responsibilities for food safety and quality, and ensure annual reviews are conducted and signed.
clause_mappings.findingReason: This document is specifically an Integrated Pest Management SOP and does not contain evidence related to Management Commitment.

clause_mappings.requirement: A multi-disciplinary food safety team shall develop a food safety plan utilizing HACCP principles, defining CCPs, limits, monitoring, and validation procedures. Plan must be reviewed at least annually, and signed by the SQF practitioner.
clause_mappings.findingReason: This document is specifically an Integrated Pest Management SOP and does not define the Food Safety HACCP Plan.

clause_mappings.requirement: A training program shall be documented, mapping necessary competencies to operational tasks. Training records must be maintained, including dates, attendee signatures, competence evaluations, and trainer sign-offs.
clause_mappings.findingReason: This document details pest management SOP, not the general employee training program.

clause_mappings.requirement: The pest prevention program shall be documented, detailing bait mapping, chemical safety data sheets, applicator licensing, and inspection frequencies. Methods shall be effective in protecting food products from contamination.
clause_mappings.excerpt: INTEGRATED PEST MANAGEMENT STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE Document ID: APEX-SOP-Pest-Control Revision: 2.0 Effective Date: January 15, 2025 Review Date: January 15, 2026 Owner: Quality Assurance Department
clause_mappings.findingReason: The document establishes a written Standard Operating Procedure for Integrated Pest Management (IPM), fulfilling the SQF requirement for a documented pest prevention program.

clause_mappings.requirement: Water and steam used in food processing must comply with local potability standards. Water safety must be verified at least annually through analytical laboratory microbiological and chemical testing.
clause_mappings.findingReason: This document is an Integrated Pest Management SOP and does not cover water supply requirements.

clause_mappings.requirement: An environmental monitoring program (EMP) shall be implemented for high-risk processing zones to monitor for pathogen presence. The program must specify sampling plans, corrective actions for positives, and continuous verification.
clause_mappings.findingReason: This document details pest management SOP, not the environmental monitoring program.
